## What's Changed

- Added chained subscription proxies. Clash `dialer-proxy` and sing-box `detour` references now retain upstream nodes and static selector or URL-test groups instead of dropping otherwise supported nodes.
- Kept chain references stable across node and group renames. Missing, circular, unsupported, filtered, or disabled dependencies are reported rather than silently bypassed.
- Fixed Hysteria v1 configuration validation when subscriptions include both `password` and `auth-str`. Existing imported nodes retain their authentication without emitting the unsupported `password` field.
- Fixed plain Shadowsocks nodes being incorrectly filtered when TLS is explicitly disabled but certificate-verification flags are present.
- Routed chained-node latency probes through the core and prevented standalone sharing links from silently losing upstream dependencies.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ackwrap/ackrun/compare/v1.0.7...v1.0.8
